ValidationRule.description: Validation rule to ensure certain fields are filled in before Ready to Submit can be set to TRUE.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: Ready_to_Submit__c = TRUE && (ISBLANK(Role__c) || ISPICKVAL(Plan_Type__c, "") || ISPICKVAL(Type__c, "") || ISBLANK(OTV_2__c) || ISPICKVAL(OTV_2_Currency__c, "") || ISBLANK(NNBARV_Quota__c) || ISBLANK(OTV_3__c) || ISPICKVAL(OTV_3_Currency__c, "") || ISBLANK(Renewal_Quota__c))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The following fields must have a value before you can check off Ready to Submit: Role, Plan Type,Type, Primary OTV, Primary OTV Currency, Primary Quota, Renewal OTV, Renewal OTV Currency, and Renewal Quota.
